entities.name: UniProt Q14703
observations: Reviewed human membrane-bound transcription factor site-1 protease; sequence query matches at 100% identity and 100% query coverage.

Calcium-dependent serine endoprotease (EC 3.4.21.112) that hydrolyzes peptide bonds after hydrophobic or small P1 residues when Arg/Lys is at P4; cleavage-site preference is relatively relaxed at P1/P3.
Curated examples include cleavage after RSVL in SREBP2, RHLL in ATF6, RGLT in BDNF, and RRLL in its propeptide.

entities.name: Site-1 protease peptide hydrolysis
observations: Hydrolyzes a peptide bond in precursor proteins: polypeptide + H2O → peptide fragments with a newly formed carboxyl terminus and amino terminus; cleavage commonly follows a hydrophobic or small residue at P1, with Arg/Lys at P4.
